summarization: This smartphone UI screen provides information about the nutritional categorization of "Yellow" foods. It explains that yellow foods typically have more calories and/or less healthy nutrients per serving compared to green foods. It advises that these foods should be consumed in moderate proportions. Examples of yellow foods include lean meats and starches. The screen emphasizes that while these foods are not inherently bad, they should be eaten in moderation. At the bottom of the screen, there is an "OK" button for the user to acknowledge and close the information.
